app.title: Image Generator
app.subtitle: Securely configure an OpenAI-compatible image service so your catgirl can create images from natural-language requests.
overview.label: Runtime overview
stat.runtime_ready: Plugin is loaded and accepting requests
stat.runtime_stopped: Enable the plugin in Plugin Manager
stat.key_missing: Save an API key before generating
settings.title: Service and generation settings
settings.subtitle: The complete save payload is encrypted in this browser with a short-lived one-time public-key envelope; task arguments contain ciphertext only.
help.api_base_url: Leave the default unless you run a self-hosted or local service.
help.provider: After choosing a provider you usually only need the API key; Base URL and model are prefilled.
help.api_key_empty: The browser encrypts the key before submission; plaintext never enters task arguments, logs, history, or call results.
help.api_key_configured: A key is saved. A replacement is encrypted in this browser; leave this blank to keep the saved key.
help.list: Separate values with commas; the first value can also become the default.
help.style_list: Use "" to omit the style parameter from provider requests.
help.auto_show: After success, show the image link directly in the current chat.
placeholder.api_key_configured: Securely configured; leave blank to keep
placeholder.test_prompt: A catgirl with a star hair clip holding a clear umbrella on a neon street after rain, cinematic lighting
test.title: Test generation now
test.subtitle: Send one real request with the currently saved settings.
test.cost_warning: Your provider may charge for this test generation. Check the model and quota before continuing.
test.result_fallback: The provider returned a generation result.
activity.title: Recent generations
activity.subtitle: Only summaries and same-origin cached links are stored—never keys, remote links, or complete Base64 payloads.
history.empty_body: Generate an image in chat or in the test area above, and its summary will appear here.
status.reset_done: Defaults restored; the API key was kept
confirm.reset: Restore default settings? The API key will be kept.
confirm.clear_key: Clear the saved API key? Image generation will stop working until a new key is saved.
confirm.clear_history: Clear generation history? This does not delete the local image cache.
error.missing_run_id: The plugin service did not return a task ID
error.empty_result: The plugin returned no readable result
error.network: Could not connect to the plugin service
error.secret_envelope: The secure key envelope expired or is invalid; refresh the panel and try again
error.secret_encrypt: Could not encrypt the settings payload securely; refresh the panel and try again
error.secret_too_large: The settings payload exceeds the secure envelope size limit
error.allowlist_required: The size, quality, and style allowlists must each contain at least one value
error.default_not_allowed: Each default must appear in its corresponding allowlist
error.invalid_api_url: The API base URL must use HTTPS; only loopback development endpoints may use HTTP
error.required_fields: Enter the API address, model, and output format
error.invalid_number: {field} must be a number greater than zero
error.invalid_numeric_constraint: {field} must satisfy the allowed range and step
error.cache_too_small: Cache capacity must not be smaller than the per-image response limit
